create.name: Juha Penttilä
create.bio:
Juha Penttilä is a Finnish teacher of Insight Meditation who lives and works in Helsinki. He began meditating in 2002 and has since spent long stretches on silent retreat and in monasteries across Asia and Europe. He helped found Nirodha, the community that brings together Insight Meditation practitioners around Finland, and finished his training as an Insight Meditation teacher in 2020. Concern about the climate crisis and an interest in socially engaged Buddhism shape much of what he brings to his students.

His teaching draws on the early Buddhist foundations of mindfulness and on the emptiness teachings associated with Rob Burbea, with courses on the body as a ground for insight, on non-self, on calm and the hindrances, and on meeting the heart-mind with kindness. He leads online courses and at-home retreats for Gaia House in Devon and residential retreats for Nirodha in Finland, in English and in Finnish. He also meets students one to one, face to face in Helsinki or over Zoom, on a donation basis. Recordings of his courses are shared through Dharma Seed, and Finnish talks and guided meditations through his Meditaatiokulma channel and podcast.

courses.title: The Body as a Foundation for Mindfulness and Insight
courses.description: A five-week online course from Gaia House on Tuesday evenings, open to all levels. Juha guides students in resting attention in the whole body through walking, standing, sitting and lying down, and then in looking at bodily experience through impermanence, unsatisfactoriness and not-self. Sessions are recorded for anyone who misses one.

courses.title: A Natural Deepening; Following the Beautiful Breath
courses.description: A nine-week online course from Gaia House on Thursday evenings, co-taught with Yahel Avigur, for people with at least a week of previous retreat practice. It works with the breath and the body as a basis for steadier attention and for insight into how experience is put together.

courses.title: Cittanupassana: Turning towards the heart-mind (New Year's Retreat)
courses.description: A silent residential retreat taught in English with Laura Bridgman at the Friendship Inn in Kruusila, near Salo in south-west Finland. It explores the third foundation of mindfulness, noticing the moods and states of the heart-mind and learning to meet them with understanding, and includes sitting, walking, some mindful bodywork and relational practice. Beginners are welcome; meals are vegetarian and rooms shared.
courses.price: €290 EUR (base price; pay more or less)

courses.title: One-to-one meditation sessions
courses.description: Regular conversations with Juha about your practice, in person in Helsinki or on Zoom, lasting 30 or 55 minutes roughly every three or four weeks. Themes might include a steady daily practice, the inner critic, samadhi, letting go or emptiness, following whatever is most alive for you.

free_resources.title: Foundations of Meditation
free_resources.description: Recordings of a free four-week online beginners' course Juha taught for Gaia House in 2021, each week mixing teaching with a guided meditation: posture, basic mindfulness, calm, the common hindrances, kindness and letting go.

free_resources.title: Exploring Anatta (online series)
free_resources.description: A recorded online series on not-self, in which Juha teaches two meditative ways of seeing how the sense of self is built up moment by moment and how it can be held more lightly in daily life.
